title: lastrea arguta
intro: Lastrea arguta, commonly known as the lesser sword fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and aiding in the treatment of various skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea arguta are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
